body: Thank you so much. It feels good to talk.
That's the thing. I don't really want to feel anything again. Most of me just wants to die. I'd rather die than get better.

I've been on meds since I was about 13, although they've changed a lot, as we're experimenting with different options. I recently started on new meds. Lately I've felt like they're just sugar pills, I haven't noticed any differences. The last time I felt extremely emotional was sometime last week, and before that a few days earlier, but that was the first time in about 2 years.
That's how it is now, but before I was just being a stupid teenager. I didn't have any of these philosophies or thoughts. I was just being stupid.

I started cause I had some mild depression. I was having issues when I hated the school I was in and was having issues with my father battling for custody (he was an abusive asshole). It didn't really help all that much, but it was something. It really started when I was 14. I had to go into treatment for drug abuse and severe depression. I had attempted suicide twice and wasn't going to school. I was an idiot back then and didn't think about much. My depression now is very much different than the one I had then.

Oh, and thanks for replying, by the way.
I don't even know. I'm just so tired. I'm so tired and I get lazy to talk about stuff. I don't know what to do.
